mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a decline in consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS drop does not correlate with subsequent consumer sentiment or spending indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent economic growth indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between high FEDFUNDS and low CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent negative market performance.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of instances with PAYEMS increase, or PAYEMS increase does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or HOUST drop does not correlate with subsequent negative housing market indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and unemployment (UNRATE) is falling, it signals a strong economic environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic expansion with labor market tightening
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction between rising INDPRO and falling UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent positive market performance.
